description: From PR #107 gating audit (pre-existing): PersistencePhase rewrites shard_keys/ entries each recovery but never clear-ranges the prefix first — a shrinking shard layout leaves stale entries that a later bootstrap read would treat as live shards. Harmless while layouts only grow; must be fixed in/before q67.9 when this becomes the durable shard map (add clear_range over the shard_keys/ prefix in the system transaction, which also exercises Metadata's clear_range path — note RoutingData currently ignores clear_range entirely, same audit).

comments.text: Fix landed on feature/q67-shard-key-clearing (df2d3239), draft PR #110 into feature/q67-phase-a. PersistencePhase clear_ranges shard_keys/, shards/, and layout/logs/ prefixes (KeyRange.from_prefix) before rewriting; RoutingData now applies clear_range mirroring Metadata #105 semantics. Survey: layout_services/layout_id single-key (no staleness); materializer_keys/ has no writer yet. Not closing per instructions.

title: PersistencePhase never clears stale shard_key entries before rewrite
